rules.name: CBAM Declarant ID Required for Submission
rules.description: An EU CBAM declarant ID must be registered before submitting CBAM reports to the EU Registry.
rules.message_template: CBAM Declarant ID is missing. Register at the EU CBAM Transitional Registry before submitting.

rules.name: Reporting Period Completeness — All Quarters Required
rules.description: CBAM quarterly report must cover all calendar months in the quarter with no gaps.
rules.message_template: CBAM report data completeness is {report.data_completeness_pct}%. All import records for the quarter must be included.

rules.name: CBAM Goods CN Code Required
rules.description: Each CBAM goods line item must have a valid Combined Nomenclature (CN) code.
rules.message_template: CBAM CN codes are missing. Specify the 8-digit CN code for each CBAM good imported.

rules.name: Default Value Flag — 3x Certificate Multiplier Disclosure
rules.description: When CBAM default values are used (no verified actuals), importers must declare this and the 3x certificate multiplier applies.
rules.message_template: This report uses CBAM default emission values. Per Art. 9(2), the 3x certificate multiplier will apply. Consider obtaining verified actual emission data from your supplier.

rules.name: Verifier Sign-Off Required for Verified Actuals
rules.description: Actual emission values (as opposed to defaults) must be verified by an EU-accredited verifier.
rules.message_template: Verified actual emissions require sign-off from an EU-accredited verifier. Assign a verifier in the Verification tab.

rules.name: Submission Deadline — 31 Days After Quarter End
rules.description: CBAM reports must be submitted within 31 days of the end of each calendar quarter.
rules.message_template: CBAM quarterly report deadline is approaching. {report.days_until_deadline} days remaining. Deadline: 31 days after quarter-end.

rules.name: Carbon Price Adjustment — Domestic Carbon Tax Credit
rules.description: Any carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin must be deducted from CBAM certificate obligation.
rules.message_template: No domestic carbon price has been declared. If a carbon tax was paid in India (e.g. Coal Cess), this can reduce your CBAM certificate obligation. Review India Carbon Market developments.
